mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines for 3 consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 130000 for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals strengthening aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 increases for 3 consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 130000 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 130000 for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for 3 consecutive quarters and HOUST < 1500 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines for 3 consecutive quarters and HOUST < 1500 for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
